description: Six captured discovery queries (102 visible rendered headers) mostly returned material about the 2018 protest cycle, an Argentina university-strike item, historical labor chronologies, pre-month human-rights context, or an empty 100noticias domain search. No October 2024 in-country public gathering meeting the event definition was established in these saved results. This is a search limitation, not evidence that no gathering occurred.
required_followup: Continue with date-specific searches in independent Nicaraguan/local outlets and regional/sector terms (Managua, León, Masaya, Matagalpa, Estelí; labor, health, education, rural, transport, pensioners). Seek public occurrence, simultaneous count and explicit own-state demand; do not infer events from repression reports or out-of-month material.
